Overview

Izo (Samurai) is a MythicalMythical. He can only be obtained by evolving Izo (Black Fire). He is also the boss of stage 5 of Storm Hideout in The Final Confrontation.

Evolving

Izo (Samurai) can be evolved from Izo (Black Fire) with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive Ability: Black Flames

Enemies can take more Burn DoT and he can deal 100% burn damage making his burn DPS very efficient. it's also really good for Fire Affinity Stages (weakness), or any stages with Ice enemies involved, such as Magic Town or Clover Kingdom.

However, it's worth noting that since half of his damage comes from burn, he isn't as effective against Regen enemies. This is because burn damage is dealt over time; as a result, it gives Regen enemies time to heal. Consider a Regen enemy with 2000 HP, an Itochi (Susanoo) that does 1000 damage plus 1000 burn, and a different character that does 2000 damage. Since Itochi (Susanoo)'s burn occurs over time, the enemy would be able to regen and survive his attack. On the other hand, the character that dealt the damage all at once would prevent regeneration from occurring.

With the Infernal Gaze, his Burn Damage will be doubled and given his duration of 10 ticks (100% before the relic is applied), he would technically deal triple damage if including his normal damage. A max level Izo (Samurai) can deal up to 660k+ damage with his burn, each burn dealing around 30k damage and also adding on the initial attack damage. His burn stacks with other burn units.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

Itachi's Shiny skin is him at the age of 11, from when he joined the Leaf Village's Special Anbu Force.
